Home.title: i3 — Tools related IIIF
Home.description: A small set of tools bridging the IIIF Presentation API and Curation API 1.0 for IIIF. Everything runs in the browser, and each conversion is also available as an API.
Home.note: These are lightweight tools and may contain defects. Please use them as a reference.
Home.converterDesc: Converts between IIIF Manifests and Curation Lists, to verify that the two are largely inter-convertible.
Home.comparisonDesc: Loads a Curation List and places the cropped regions side by side — useful for comparing similar figures held by different institutions.
Home.mapDesc: Displays and searches a large number of annotations on a single large image, such as a map. Search a place name to zoom to it.
Home.apiDesc: Conversion is stateless, so the API URL itself is a durable URI for the converted resource. Hand it straight to Self Museum or the IIIF Curation Viewer.

Converter.title: IIIF Converter
Converter.description: Converts between IIIF Manifests and Curation Lists. Accepts IIIF Presentation API v2 or v3 as input.
Converter.toCurationDesc: Turns an annotated Manifest into a Curation List of cropped regions, ready to load into Self Museum and similar viewers.
Converter.toCollectionDesc: Turns a Curation List into a IIIF Collection of the Manifests it draws from.
Converter.label: Label

Comparison.title: IIIF Curation Comparison
Comparison.description: Places the cropped images of a Curation List side by side for comparison.
Comparison.selectHint: Choose the regions you want to compare (multiple allowed).

MapSearch.title: IIIF Curation Map Search
MapSearch.description: Displays and searches a large number of annotations on a single large image.
MapSearch.clickToZoom: Click an item in the list to zoom to that region.
